## About
Land-N-Lawns is a full service, hands on landscape company. It started back when we were in college, mowing residential lawns, and that work led us into landscaping, turf installation and tree services.
Our goal is to maintain the value of your landscape investment through proper care and sustainable enhancements, at a fair price. Today we work on homes, new developments, offices and shopping centers in and around San Antonio.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 50 Google reviews. One of them put it simply: Matt and his crew did an excellent job.

## Services
- Lawn maintenance / mowing: Regular lawn care for homes and commercial properties. It's where Land-N-Lawns got its start.
- Landscaping, turf installation: New grass, yard makeovers and planting. One of our projects started with tilling a weedy yard, adding topsoil and laying St. Augustine grass.
- Soil - Mulch - Rock - Sand: Delivered and installed. We've laid Medina River Rock, also known as Texas Blend, over landscape fabric to keep weeds from coming back.
- Tree services: Trimming, shaping, hauling away and tree installation, for palms, oaks, mesquites and more.
- Tree removals and directional pruning: From full removals to directional pruning, we leave your yard as clean as we found it.
- Irrigation work: One customer called us for urgent irrigation work on his lawn and said the crew went above and beyond to get it done.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of trees do you work on?
A: Palms, oaks, mesquites and whatever else you've got. Safety and preserving the tree come first.

Q: Can you help get a listing ready to sell?
A: Yes. A realtor told us her new listing needed curb appeal, and she and her client were both happy with the result.

Q: Do you sell plants?
A: Yes. Land-N-Lawns is licensed to sell nursery and floral products and is registered with the Texas Department of Agriculture.
